name: South Berwick Open 2016

venue.name: Berwick Academy
venue.details: The competition will be held in the large Commons area of Berwick Academy.

information:
This is the second ever competition in Maine! It will be held at Berwick Academy in South Berwick, Maine!
There will be an 85 competitor limit, and the entrance fee is $15. To complete your registration, click [THIS LINK ](https://www.paypal.com/cgi-bin/webscr?cmd=_xclick&business=H4C72KVA5K52U&lc=US&item_name=South%20Berwick%20Open%202016%20Registration&amount=15%2e00&currency_code=USD&button_subtype=services&tax_rate=0%2e000&shipping=0%2e00&bn=PP%2dBuyNowBF%3abtn_buynowCC_LG%2egif%3aNonHosted)to pay for the competitor fee. Once your payment has been reviewed, you will be moved from the waiting list into the registered list. Please keep in mind that clicking this link means that you have fully read and understood all information regarding the competition, and that you will not hold Berwick Academy liable for any loss of property, automotive damage, bodily injury, or any expenses arising from the competition.
